quickEntry.selectNoteAria: Select a note to add a new task to
quickEntry.toAria: Show tasks up to this date
quickEntry.appendTaskAria: Append new task to selected note
quickEntry.tagAria: Show only tasks with this tag

notices.impossibleDate: “{text}” has a {field} date that does not exist ({value}). Nothing was written.
notices.unreadableReturnedDate: Tasks returned a date the timeline cannot read back (“{token}”) for “{text}”. Nothing was written.
notices.unreadableChangedDate: “{text}” would get a date the timeline cannot read back (“{token}”). Nothing was written.
notices.localDigits: Tasks wrote it in the digits of Obsidian's language ({locale}).
notices.recurrenceLost: Tasks could not read the recurrence rule in “{text}” and would drop it. Nothing was written. Fix the rule in the note, then try again.
notices.recurringNeedsTasks: Recurring tasks need the Tasks plugin. Nothing was written.
notices.notTaskLine: The timeline can't change “{text}” safely because it isn't a plain task line. Open the note to change it.
notices.ambiguous: “{text}” appears more than once near here in {note}, and the timeline can't tell which one you clicked. Nothing was written.
notices.movedOrDeleted: {prefix}{note} was moved or deleted. Nothing was written.
notices.notUtf8: {note} is not saved as UTF-8. Nothing was written: writing would replace its unreadable characters (shown as �) for good. Convert the note to UTF-8 to edit its tasks from the timeline.
notices.queueBlocked: {note} may not have been saved yet. The timeline won't change it until the note changes or two minutes pass.
notices.dateAmbiguous: “{text}” has more than one {field} date ({a} and {b}). Nothing was changed. Keep one of them in the note, then try again.
notices.dateUnreadable: “{text}” has its {field} date written as {found}, which the timeline cannot change. Nothing was changed. Edit it in the note.
notices.dateStyleMixed: “{text}” uses both emoji dates and [key:: value] fields, so the timeline cannot tell which style to add. Nothing was changed. Add the {field} date in the note.
notices.lineChanged: “{text}” changed in {note} since the timeline read it. Nothing was written. The timeline updates once Obsidian has re-read the note; then try again.
notices.notReread: Obsidian hasn't re-read {note} yet, so the timeline can't change “{text}” again. Try again in a moment.
notices.tasksTooOld: Completing from the timeline needs Tasks 7.2.0 or newer, so the note was opened at the task.
notices.tasksError: Tasks could not change “{text}”: {message}. Nothing was written.
notices.badOutput: Tasks returned something the timeline cannot write safely for “{text}”. Nothing was written.
notices.undoChanged: Could not undo: “{text}” in {note} changed or moved after the timeline wrote it. Nothing was written.
notices.mayNotSavedTimeout: {note} may not have been saved: the file system didn't answer within 60 s. Check the note before trying again.
notices.mayNotSavedEditor: {note} may not have been saved: Obsidian could not save it, and the line changed in its editor afterwards. The change is still in the open note and is saved with it. Check the note before trying again.
notices.slow: Saved in {note}. The timeline will show the change once Obsidian has re-read the note.
notices.tasksDialogError: Could not reach the Tasks plugin: {reason}
notices.tasksDialogDelete: Nothing was written. If you completed this task in the dialog: Tasks returns nothing for a task set to delete itself, so use the checkbox to complete it.
notices.recurringReplaced: Completed “{task}” in {note}; it was replaced by the next occurrence.
notices.recurringAdded: Completed “{task}” in {note}; the next occurrence was added.
notices.undoAlready: “{task}” in {note} is already back to how it was.
notices.undoExpired: Could not undo: the change to “{task}” was too long ago. Nothing was written.
notices.overwritten: “{task}” in {note} is back to how it was before the timeline changed it (another save, a sync, or a change made in the note). Redo?
notices.overwrittenMany: {count} timeline changes in {note} are back to how they were before (another save, a sync, or a change made in the note). Redo?
notices.dialogChangesNotUndone: Changes the Tasks dialog made to other tasks are not undone.
notices.copyFailure: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
notices.reloadFailure: Error when generating tasks from files: {reason}
notices.readFailures: Tasks Calendar Wrapper: {count} file(s) could not be read, their tasks are missing. See the developer console.
notices.settingsUnreadable: Tasks Calendar Wrapper: data.json changed outside Obsidian but could not be read, so the settings stay as they were; the next change of a setting saves them. See the developer console.
notices.openViewFailure: Failed to open the timeline view. See the developer console for details.
notices.queuedTargetChanged: A queued task target changed notes.

modals.createNoteMessage: No such file: {path}. Would you like to create it?
modals.removeRecurrenceMessage: The edited task no longer repeats. If you cleared Recurs, save it. If you did not, Tasks could not read the rule in “{expected}” and dropped it.
modals.whatsNewTitle: What's new in Tasks Calendar Wrapper
modals.support: If you find this plugin useful, a star on GitHub or your support for its development helps a lot.

openViewOnStartup.name: Open view on startup
openViewOnStartup.desc: Open the view on startup or not.

showWhatsNewOnUpdate.name: Show what's new after updates
showWhatsNewOnUpdate.desc: Show the release notes once after the plugin is updated. They can always be opened with the "Show what's new" command.

filterEmpty.name: Filter empty
filterEmpty.desc: Filter empty items out or not. If not, the raw text will be displayed.

excludePaths.name: Exclude paths
excludePaths.desc: Exclude tasks match specific paths (folders, files).
excludePaths.placeholder: comma separated file paths, e.g.: path1,path2/path3,path4.md

includePaths.name: Include paths
includePaths.desc: Include tasks match specific paths (folders, files).
includePaths.placeholder: comma separated file paths, e.g.: path1,path2/path3,path4.md

useIncludeTags.name: Use include tags
useIncludeTags.desc: Use tags filters to filter tasks without specific tags out or not.

taskIncludeTags.name: Task include filters
taskIncludeTags.desc: Filter tasks with specific tags, only tasks with one or more of these tags are displayed.

fileIncludeTags.name: File include tags
fileIncludeTags.desc: Filter tasks in specific files which contains one or more of these tags to be displayed.

useExcludeTags.name: Use exclude tags
useExcludeTags.desc: Use tags filters to filters tasks with specific tags out or not.

taskExcludeTags.name: Task exclude filters
taskExcludeTags.desc: Filter tasks without specific tags, only tasks **without any** if these tags are displayed.

fileExcludeTags.name: File exclude tags
fileExcludeTags.desc: Filter tasks in specific files which **does not** contains any of these tags to be displayed.

excludeProperties.name: Exclude properties
excludeProperties.desc: Exclude tasks of files whose frontmatter property has one of these values. One property per line, values separated by commas.

dailyNoteFolder.name: Daily note folder
dailyNoteFolder.desc: Specify the folder where the daily notes are saved.

dailyNoteFormat.name: Daily note format
dailyNoteFormat.desc: Daily note file format. The format sould be of moment format, see

sectionForNewTasks.name: Section for new tasks
sectionForNewTasks.desc: Specify under which section the new task items should be appended.

hideTags.name: Hide tags
hideTags.desc: Specify which tags are not necessary to display with a tag badge, note that all tag texts are remove from the displayed item text by default. Also note that the tags are just hided, not removed from the item.

forward.name: Forward tasks from past
forward.desc: Forward overdue tasks from the past and all unplanned tasks to display them on the today panel or not.

forwardPastStartAndScheduled.name: Forward started and scheduled tasks
forwardPastStartAndScheduled.desc: Also show tasks that have started or were scheduled before today on the today panel. They are shown there instead of on their own date.

forwardUndatedDone.name: Forward undated done tasks
forwardUndatedDone.desc: Show done tasks that have no date at all on the today panel. Turn it off to keep them out of the timeline.

sort.name: Sort by
sort.desc: Specify how you would like the taks item to be sorted inside a date.

dateFormat.name: Date format
dateFormat.desc: Specify format you would like to use for dates. Note that the format should be of moment format. See

inbox.name: Inbox
inbox.desc: Set a file as an 'Inbox' for task items from the quick entry panel. This file will be displayed on top of the file list.

taskFiles.name: Tasks files
taskFiles.desc: Task Files you would like to specify explicitly for quick entry panel. make sure paths are separated by , .
taskFiles.placeholder: comma separated file paths, e.g.: path1,path2

tagColorPalette.name: Tag and color
tagColorPalette.desc: Enter tag text (# included) in the text input and select color in the color selector.

useCounters.name: Enable counters and filters panel
useCounters.desc: Use counters and filters on the quick entry panel or not.

counterBehavior.name: Behavior of counters and filters panel
counterBehavior.desc: Set the default behavior of the counter and filter buttons. Available choices are: *Filter* to filter other items out, or *Focus* to make selected items more clear.

useQuickEntry.name: Enable quick entry panel
useQuickEntry.desc: Use quick entry panel or not.

entryPosition.name: Quick entry panel position
entryPosition.desc: Where you like the entry panel to be, * Top means on top of the view, * Bottom means on bottom of the view, * Today means in today's view.

useYearHeader.name: Enable year header
useYearHeader.desc: Display the year on top of tasks of that year or not.

newestFirst.name: Newest first
newestFirst.desc: Show the latest dates on top instead of the earliest.

useRelative.name: Use relative date
useRelative.desc: Use relative date to describe the task dates or not.

useRecurrence.name: Use recurrence
useRecurrence.desc: Display the recurrence information of tasks or not.

usePriority.name: Use priority
usePriority.desc: Display the priority information of tasks or not.

useTags.name: Use tags
useTags.desc: Display the tags of tasks or not. Color palette can be defined for tags!

useFileBadge.name: Use filename
useFileBadge.desc: Display which file the task is from or not.

useSection.name: Use section
useSection.desc: Display which section the task is from or not.

useModifyBadge.name: Use modify badge
useModifyBadge.desc: Display the badge that opens a task in the Tasks plugin dialog or not.

openNoteInsteadOfInPlace.name: Open the note instead of changing tasks in place
openNoteInsteadOfInPlace.desc: The checkbox and ✏️ open the note at the task instead of changing it from the timeline. While this is on, ✏️ does not open Tasks' edit dialog. While it is off, the timeline tells you when another save changes its edit back within a few seconds, but it cannot notice every such change, for example a note replaced by an old synced copy.

newDateStyle.name: Style for new dates
newDateStyle.desc: Used when the timeline adds a date to a task line that has no task fields yet (no dates, priority, recurrence or other Tasks fields). Lines that already use one style keep it. If the Tasks plugin is set to the Dataview format, choose Dataview fields.

hideStatusTasks.name: Hide tasks of specific status
hideStatusTasks.desc: Provide comma split status markers, e.g.,: x, - Use [ ] if you would like to hide all tasks with marker [ ] or status todo.
hideStatusTasks.placeholder: Status markers split by comma. e.g.,: x, -.

hideSubTasks.name: Hide subtasks
hideSubTasks.desc: Hide task items that are nested under another list item.

defaultTodayFocus.name: Today focus on load
defaultTodayFocus.desc: Activate today focus on load or not.

useBuiltinStyle.name: Use builtin style
useBuiltinStyle.desc: Use builtin styles (the marker icons for task status) or not. If disabled, styles defined by the theme you are using will be used.

convert24HourTimePrefix.name: Convert time prefix
convert24HourTimePrefix.desc: Convert 24 hour time prefix to 12 hour time with am/pm. For example, 15:30 at the beginning of a task will become 3:30 pm. This is applied after sorting, enabling a chronological ordering.

tab.wrongType: Saved value is {actual}, expected {expected}. It is used as is.

expectedType.stringListMap: a map of lists of texts

tab.propertyRuleSkipped: Line {line} is skipped: it needs a property, a colon and a value.
tab.pathFilterWarning: NOTE that no prefix or trailing '/' needed, unless you want to filter the entire vault out.
tab.saveFailed: Failed to save the timeline settings. See the developer console for details.
tab.emptyColor: The color seems to be empty, maybe you forget to click the color picker.
tab.tagModalDesc: Enter tag text (# included) in the text input and select color in the color selector.
